```plato

    //==
    // # Carrying a unit coordinate onto a region
    //
    // Every sequence above lands in the unit square or cube; every pattern below
    // reports points in world space. These two are the only bridge, so the
    // mapping is stated once.

    // The unit-square coordinate carried onto the region: (0, 0) lands on Min and
    // (1, 1) on Max.
    FromUnitSquare(region: Bounds2D, u: Point2D): Point2D
        => Point2D(region.Min.X.Lerp(region.Max.X, u.X), region.Min.Y.Lerp(region.Max.Y, u.Y));
```
